adjudication: All 35 whole native crops reviewed. All retained final original-pixel lettering snippets inspected; model clear statuses and reviewer completion claims are not evidence by themselves.
Combined Broad Cove Chapel, More Brook, Broad Cove River, Proposed Railway, LOCH BAN, MABOU HIGHLANDS, Northeast Mabou River and Glendyer Brook from their complete cross-crop lettering.

Native rotation reads Trap Hill and Rusty Brown Sand. Reject invented St Croix, McKenzie/Mackay names in the diorite caption and the Sandstone suffix. Native source includes Dark gray diorite and Iron Pyrites.
Expanded S. & G. Mill beyond the clipped initial box; kept adjacent C. Mill separate. Native context resolves Eng. Slope, J. Y. Gunn and Dr Gunn without expanding abbreviations.
Parent whole-crop audit added five omitted facilities: school near Mabou Coal Mines, school below Mound Young, post office and forge at Glen Dhu, and shop at Hay River.

Parent inspection repaired empty/displaced Glen Dhu or Alexander boxes, clipped Mabou Coal Mines and Thomas Burke, the M in MABOU, and full Brook/River captions. Identical overlap records merged once.
Five readings remain qualified: three dense coal-seam numeral/raised-mark combinations, the Ron./Hon. abbreviation after Widow, and Mound/Mount Young. No seam thickness inferred from ambiguous marks.
Original four invalid responses remain preserved with their rejected model boxes. No rerun or silent conversion to accepted model output.
limitations: Finalized means the initial source inventory and crop audit are complete with explicit qualified readings. It does not certify infallibility, geographic placement, georeferencing acceptance, feature survival, ownership or current site conditions.
